title: The Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem, Bombieri 1965 and A. I. Vinogradov 1965, classical form with the maximum over y <= x
abstract: A sorry-free Lean 4 proof of the Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem in its classical form: for every A > 0 there is B > 0 such that the sum over q <= x^{1/2} (log x)^{-B} of the maximum over y <= x and over reduced residues a mod q of |psi(y; q, a) - y/phi(q)| is << x (log x)^{-A}. The same form is proved for theta(y; q, a), for pi(y; q, a) against liD(y)/phi(q) with liD(y) the sum of 1/log n over 2 <= n <= y, and for pi(y; q, a) against pi(y)/phi(q), the level of distribution 1/2 input of sieve methods. The proof runs from a zero-free region for Dirichlet L-functions and Siegel's theorem through the Siegel-Walfisz theorem, the multiplicative large sieve and Vaughan's identity; all constants are ineffective, as in the papers. Binary Goldbach is open and is not claimed. The Lean code was written by an AI agent; the statements were checked against the literature by AI reviewers and are offered for human audit.
